name: NoLiMa
description: NoLiMa is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' long-context understanding beyond literal matching by requiring models to infer latent associations to locate relevant information within long irrelevant contexts. It extends the needle-in-a-haystack test by minimizing lexical overlap between questions and needles, challenging models' retrieval capabilities in long contexts.
reputation: A recent research benchmark that has been cited as a stronger long-context retrieval test than simple needle-in-a-haystack setups, but it is not yet widely standardized in leaderboards.
notes: Focuses on long-context evaluation with minimal lexical overlap; publicly releases dataset and evaluation code.
